body: ### What are you really trying to do? We've implemented the long-running-poller pattern (c.f. https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/issues/1420), and it works fine. However, it causes all of our workflows to show as errored in our tracing system. I don't like this behaviour and do not think it is intentional. ### Describe the bug When `CompleteAsyncError` is thrown by our activity, the span representing the activity gets marked as 'ERROR', with an exception, an ERROR log, and a stack trace. I would like these spans to show as regular error free spans, either completed, or still running with the background polling loop in the same span. ``` CompleteAsyncError at (/app/src/lib/activities/[..] at async wrapWithSpan (/app/node_modules/@temporalio/interceptors-opentelemetry/src/instrumentation.ts:61:17) at async (/app/node_modules/@temporalio/interceptors-opentelemetry/src/instrumentation.ts:125:65) at async instrument (/app/node_modules/@temporalio/interceptors-opentelemetry/src/instrumentation.ts:125:10) at async OpenTelemetryActivityInboundInterceptor.execute (/app/node_modules/@temporalio/interceptors-opentelemetry/src/worker/index.ts:52:12) at async Activity.execute (/app/node_modules/@temporalio/worker/src/activity.ts:138:14) at async NativeConnection.withAbortSignal (/app/node_modules/@temporalio/worker/src/connection.ts:220:12) at async Client.withAbortSignal (/app/node_modules/@temporalio/client/src/base-client.ts:105:12) at async (/app/node_modules/@temporalio/worker/src/activity.ts:192:24) ``` ### Environment/Versions - OS and processor: arm64 ubuntu in docker on mac, arm64 linux on fargate/eks. - Temporal Version: `@temporalio/interceptors-opentelemetry@1.15.0`, cloud, `temporalio/temporal:latest`. - Are you using Docker or Kubernetes or building Temporal from source? Official npm packages, cloud. ### Additional context Maybe `allowedExceptions:` on the instrumentation function? https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/blob/a2b2956c368f452dac24a2dd0f142c3c20800517/packages/interceptors-opentelemetry/src/worker/index.ts#L52-L62
title: [Bug] OTel traces for CompleteAsyncError show as error
